label: 怪物图鉴效果 Bestiary Effects

Effect: Swarming Bites.name: 效果：集群噬咬 Swarming Bites
Effect: Swarming Bites.description: 你陷入笨拙1。当你受到该效果影响，并且尝试带有专注或操作特征的动作，你必须通过@Check[flat|dc:5|showDC:all]检定否则会丢失该动作；该纯骰检定在动作结束之后，效果生效之前进行。

Effect: Consume Memories.name: 效果：吞噬记忆 Consume Memories
Effect: Consume Memories.description: 作为吞噬记忆的结果，沃达凯于1分钟内在所有的技能检定中获得+1状态加值。

Effect: Oceanic Armor.name: Effect: Oceanic Armor
Effect: Oceanic Armor.description: The creature gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

Effect: Nature's Infusion.name: 效果：自然注能 Nature's Infusion
Effect: Nature's Infusion.description: 布劳德韦德获得15点临时生命值。

Effect: Fanatical Frenzy.name: 效果：狂热激怒 Fanatical Frenzy
Effect: Fanatical Frenzy.description: 你的攻击检定获得+1状态加值，伤害检定获得+2状态加值，AC获得-2状态减值。

Effect: Deny Fate.name: Effect: Deny Fate
Effect: Deny Fate.description: When you roll initiative, you automatically roll a 1.

Effect: Despair.name: 效果：绝望灵光 Despair
Effect: Despair.description: 灵光范围内活着的生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。它无法从这种恐惧中自然恢复，但只要离开灵光范围就能立即恢复。

Effect: Engulf and Swallow Whole.name: 效果：包卷和活吞 Engulf and Swallow Whole
Effect: Engulf and Swallow Whole.description:
效果来自@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.zU3Ovaet4xQ5Gmvy]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

你陷入受擒，缓慢1，并且必须屏住呼吸，否则便会开始窒息。你可以攻击效果来源，但是仅能以无武装攻击或是轻负载及更小的武器进行攻击。来源的生物在对抗此攻击时视为措手不及。如果效果来源于单次攻击或法术中受到的穿刺或挥砍伤害等于或超过所列的破裂值（Rupture），你重获自由。

Effect: Resonance.name: 效果：共鸣 Resonance
Effect: Resonance.description: 你在具有选定特征的效果上的攻击骰和伤害骰获得+1状态加值；具有元素和选定特征的生物在所有攻击和伤害骰上获得该加值。

Effect: Absorb Memories.name: 效果：吸取记忆 Absorb Memories
Effect: Absorb Memories.description: 生物所有技能检定中获得+1状态加值。

Effect: Darivan's Bloodline Magic.name: 效果：达利梵的血统奥秘 Darivan's Bloodline Magic
Effect: Darivan's Bloodline Magic.description: 达利梵的血统奥秘被激活时，他的动作变得超自然的优雅和使人分神，他于1轮内在交涉检定上获得+1状态加值，或者一个目标于1轮内在意志豁免上承受-1状态减值。

Effect: Sacrifice Armor.name: 效果：牺牲护甲 Sacrifice Armor
Effect: Sacrifice Armor.description: 孽生废品的AC在24小时之内降低2点。孽生废品的AC不能以此方式降低至16以下。

Effect: Divine Frenzy.name: Effect: Divine Frenzy
Effect: Divine Frenzy.description: You take a –2 penalty to Perception checks and Will saves and gain a +2 status bonus to your spell DC and spell attack modifier. You can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless you're Casting a Spell or Seeking.

Effect: Asper's Elemental Aura.name: Effect: Asper's Elemental Aura
Effect: Asper's Elemental Aura.description: You gain resistance 10 to damage of the chosen element (electricity for air, fire, or cold for water). If air, you double your speed. If fire, any creature within 30 feet of you who receives fire damage receives an extra 2d10 persistent fire damage. If water, you gain fast healing 20.

Effect: Stay Strong!.name: Effect: Stay Strong!
Effect: Stay Strong!.description: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the save.

Effect: Manipulate Luck (Good).name: 效果：操纵运势-好运 Manipulate Luck (Good)
Effect: Manipulate Luck (Good).description: 生物可以在接下来的1分钟内为一个d20骰投掷两次并选用更高的点数。

Effect: Venator's Mark.name: Effect: Venator's Mark
Effect: Venator's Mark.description: You take a –1 status penalty to all attacks against aeons, as well as to saving throws against efects from aeons.

Effect: Technology Control.name: Effect: Technology Control
Effect: Technology Control.description:
The target takes a -2 circumstance penalty to its attack rolls and DCs against a creature it would not normally attack.

Note: This effect applies a penalty to all rolls and DCs while active.

Effect: Hunter's Onslaught.name: Effect: Hunter's Onslaught
Effect: Hunter's Onslaught.description: You become fascinated by the marked creature and you gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last as long as the onslaught does. You gain a +8 status bonus to damage rolls against the marked enemy, and allies in a 30-foot aura around the hunter gain half that bonus.

Effect: Skin Net.name: Effect: Skin Net
Effect: Skin Net.description: You take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds.

Effect: Harmonizing Aura (Allies).name: 效果：调音灵光 - 盟友 Harmonizing Aura (Allies)
Effect: Harmonizing Aura (Allies).description: 生物在音波伤害获得+2状态加值，AC以及所有豁免在对抗音波和听觉效果时获得+1状态加值。。

Effect: Adaptive Strike.name: 效果：自适应打击 Adaptive Strike
Effect: Adaptive Strike.description: 生物特选择精金、寒铁或银；他的近战打击被视为该类型的材质。

Effect: Lantern of Hope.name: 效果：希望之灯 Lantern of Hope
Effect: Lantern of Hope.description: 生物在伤害骰和对抗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GaRQlC9Yw1BGKHfN]{极潮绝望 Wave of Despair}法术的豁免骰上获得+1状态加值。

Effect: Near-Death Experience.name: 效果：濒死体验 Near-Death Experience

Effect: Aura of Corruption.name: 效果：腐化灵光 Aura of Corruption
Effect: Aura of Corruption.description: 对于那些相较其他生物，对植物生物能造成更多伤害或麻烦的效果来说，那些在豁免检定中失败的生物会被上述效果视为植物，但这些生物不会由于被视同为植物生物而获得任何好处。

Effect: Demon-Touched Weapon.name: Effect: Demon-Touched Weapon
Effect: Demon-Touched Weapon.description: Shenga deals an additional 1d6 bleed damage with her melee Strikes.

Effect: Fanatical Frenzy (Legacy).name: Effect: Fanatical Frenzy (Legacy)
Effect: Fanatical Frenzy (Legacy).description: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls, and you take a –2 status penalty to AC.

Effect: Hampering Fusillade.name: 效果：阻碍射击 Hampering Fusillade

Effect: Field of Unholy Undeath.name: Effect: Field of Unholy Undeath
Effect: Field of Unholy Undeath.description: Undead allies within the aura gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. If the ally has void healing, they also gain fast healing 5.

Effect: Claim Corpse - Skeletal.name: 效果：占据尸体 - 骷髅 Claim Corpse - Skeletal

Effect: Aura of Disquietude.name: 效果：不安灵光 Aura of Disquietude
Effect: Aura of Disquietude.description: 由于灵光而陷入惊惧的生物不能夹击。

Effect: Primal Sink.name: Effect: Primal Sink
Effect: Primal Sink.description: You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and sap saving throw DC.

Effect: Fed by Wood.name: 效果：由木所生 Fed by Wood
Effect: Fed by Wood.description: 龙的颚咬附带的火焰伤害增加一个伤害骰。

Effect: Bittersweet Dreams.name: 效果：苦乐交织之梦 Bittersweet Dreams
Effect: Bittersweet Dreams.description: 根据豁免成功等级不同，生物在攻击骰、豁免检定、技能检定上受到状态减值。

Effect: Blood Magic.name: 效果：血统奥秘 Blood Magic
Effect: Blood Magic.description: 生物在意志豁免上获得+2状态加值。

Effect: Undead Mastery.name: 效果：不死统御 Undead Mastery
Effect: Undead Mastery.description: 生物在攻击检定、伤害检定、AC、豁免和技能检定上获得+1环境加值。

Effect: Cataclysm Brand.name: Effect: Cataclysm Brand
Effect: Cataclysm Brand.description: Your strikes deal an additional 1d10 fire damage.

Effect: Apprentice's Ambition.name: Effect: Apprentice's Ambition
Effect: Apprentice's Ambition.description: The apprentice gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.

Effect: Vomit Tar.name: 效果：呕吐焦油 Vomit Tar
Effect: Vomit Tar.description: 该生物缓慢1并获得5点火焰弱点。

Effect: Bond in Light.name: Effect: Bond in Light
Effect: Bond in Light.description: The creature glows with bright light in a 20-foot emanation and dim light to 40 feet and has fast healing 10.

Effect: Enliven Foliage.name: Effect: Enliven Foliage
Effect: Enliven Foliage.description: You take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds.

Effect: Tooth Tug.name: Effect: Tooth Tug
Effect: Tooth Tug.description: You take a –1 status penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and must succeed at a DC 5 flat check to Cast a Spell unless that spell has the subtle trait.

Effect: Bastion Aura.name: 效果：要塞灵光 Bastion Aura
Effect: Bastion Aura.description: 灵光内的善良生物只要处于此范围内便拥有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.fJSNOw4zHGbIm4bZ]{快速治疗 Fast Healing}30，并在攻击骰和伤害骰上获得+2状态加值。

Effect: Fold Form.name: 效果：折叠形态 Fold Form
Effect: Fold Form.description: 金折灵迅速展开并重新折叠自己的身体，从@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{动物形态 Animal Form}中选择一个新形态。这赋予她所选形态的移动速度和打击，但没有其他好处。它的攻击加值不变，伤害加值为+3。

Effect: Guard's Parry (Liege).name: Effect: Guard's Parry (Liege)
Effect: Guard's Parry (Liege).description: The liege gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

Effect: Invoke Rune.name: 效果：祈祷符文 Invoke Rune
Effect: Invoke Rune.description: 一个发光的符文副本出现在巨人持有的一件武器上，给与该武器所选的效果。

Effect: Vitriolic Miasma.name: Effect: Vitriolic Miasma
Effect: Vitriolic Miasma.description: You take a -2 circumstance penalty to saves against poison effects and gain weakness 10 to poison damage.

Effect: Caustic Drool.name: Effect: Caustic Drool
Effect: Caustic Drool.description: The abyssal warhound's jaws Strike deals an additional 2 points of acid damage on a successful attack, or 4 points on a critical success.

Effect: Commander's Aura.name: 效果：指挥灵光 Commander's Aura
Effect: Commander's Aura.description: 生物在攻击检定、伤害检定、AC、豁免和技能检定上获得+1环境加值。

Effect: Mist Cloud.name: 效果：迷雾灵光 Mist Cloud

Effect: Conductive Downpour.name: 效果：导电暴雨 Conductive Downpour
Effect: Conductive Downpour.description: 灵光内的生物获得10点电击弱点。

Effect: Dirty Bomb.name: 效果：脏弹 Dirty Bomb
Effect: Dirty Bomb.description: 目标对抗同一个炼金师的脏弹而进行的额外强韧豁免时，获得-2的环境减值。

Effect: Hobgoblin Phalanx.name: Effect: Hobgoblin Phalanx
Effect: Hobgoblin Phalanx.description: The regiment gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC.

Effect: Mangling Rend.name: 效果：压碎 Mangling Rend
Effect: Mangling Rend.description: 目标在任何速度上都有-20尺状态减值，直到下一回合。

Effect: Invigorating Passion.name: 效果：激情洋溢 Invigorating Passion
Effect: Invigorating Passion.description: 生物在10分钟内获得攻击骰上的+1状态加值和10点临时生命。

Effect: Flesh Mutation.name: Effect: Flesh Mutation
Effect: Flesh Mutation.description:
You are affected by a mutation according to the result.

1 Spongy Flesh You have weakness 5 to physical damage.

2 Caustic Blood You take 2d4 persistent acid damage that can't be removed normally, but ends when the mutation does.

3 Sprouting Eyes You are dazzled, but also immune to flanking.

4 Mutated Mind You are confused. You can still recover as noted in the condition, but if you do you remain off-guard until the mutation ends.

Effect: Death Gasp (Etioling).name: 效果：死亡一息 Death Gasp （衰变灵）
Effect: Death Gasp (Etioling).description: 衰变灵屏住呼吸时还额外获得虚体特征、25尺飞行速度、对全部伤害的10点抗力（除了力场、幽冥、命能；对抗非魔法伤害时抗力翻倍）。

Effect: War Leader.name: 效果：战争领袖 War Leader
Effect: War Leader.description: 生物在攻击骰和技能检定上就能获得+1状态加值。

Effect: Breach the Outer Rifts.name: Effect: Breach the Outer Rifts
Effect: Breach the Outer Rifts.description: The weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage. Roll 1d20 to determine the type: 1–7 acid, 8–9 cold, 10–11 electricity, 12–18 fire, 19–20 void.

Effect: Lurker's Glow (Critical Failure).name: 效果：伏光闪烁 Lurker's Glow （大失败）
Effect: Lurker's Glow (Critical Failure).description: 生物在效果持续时间内在20尺弥漫范围内散发明亮光照。

Effect: Burned Fingers.name: Effect: Burned Fingers
Effect: Burned Fingers.description: You take –1 circumstance penalty to Thievery checks.

Effect: Sting of the Lash.name: 效果：鞭笞之刺 Sting of the Lash

Effect: Beacon of the Rowan Guard.name: 效果：花楸守卫信标 Beacon of the Rowan Guard
Effect: Beacon of the Rowan Guard.description: 在灵光的弥漫范围中时，具有元素特征以及具有植物或木特征的生物获得10点快速治疗、且攻击骰和伤害骰有+2环境加值。

Effect: Powder Burst.name: 效果：粉末爆发 Powder Burst
Effect: Powder Burst.description: 在察觉检定和对抗心灵效果的豁免上承受-2状态减值。

Effect: Distracting Giggle.name: Effect: Distracting Giggle
Effect: Distracting Giggle.description: Creatures take a –1 status penalty to Will saves.

Effect: Diabolic Certitude.name: Effect: Diabolic Certitude
Effect: Diabolic Certitude.description: When Gredress publicly espouses the superiority of Hell, she gains a +1 status bonus to skill checks, AC, and saves for 1 day. These bonuses don't apply against devils.

Effect: Venomous Aura.name: Effect: Venomous Aura
Effect: Venomous Aura.description: You gain weakness 10 to poison (weakness 15 on a critical failure).

Effect: Destructive Vengeance.name: Effect: Destructive Vengeance
Effect: Destructive Vengeance.description: The champion deals 2 extra spirit or void damage with their Strikes against the triggering creature.

Effect: Graveknight's Curse.name: 效果：死墓骑士诅咒 Graveknight's Curse

Effect: Invigorating Spores.name: Effect: Invigorating Spores
Effect: Invigorating Spores.description: You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level, and you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage equal to half your level.

Effect: Belief Fortification.name: Effect: Belief Fortification
Effect: Belief Fortification.description: Members of the garrholdion's faction gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against emotion effects while within the aura.

Effect: Spray Toxic Oil.name: 效果：毒油喷射 Spray Toxic Oil
Effect: Spray Toxic Oil.description: 生物获得火焰弱点5，并且当生物以持握的武器进行攻击检定，得到大失败的结果时，武器掉落原地。

Effect: Reactive Detach.name: Effect: Reactive Detach
Effect: Reactive Detach.description: The sarcovalt gains resistance 5 to the triggering slashing damage.

Effect: Crush Chitin.name: 效果：碾碎甲壳 Crush Chitin

Effect: Harrowing Misfortune.name: 效果：哈罗厄运 Harrowing Misfortune
Effect: Harrowing Misfortune.description: 生物在下一次进行某个具体种类的掷骰时掷骰两次并取更低的结果，种类由卡片的花色决定。一个生物同时只能被哈罗厄运的一种效应所诅咒，新的诅咒会覆盖先前的诅咒。诅咒会在1分钟后或是该具体掷骰被进行之后结束，取其先者。花色与其对应的效应是：锤（近战攻击骰），匙（反射豁免），盾（强韧豁免），书（技能检定），星（意志豁免），冕（法术攻击骰）。

Effect: Radiate Cold.name: Effect: Radiate Cold
Effect: Radiate Cold.description:
Success You take a –5-foot status penalty to your Speeds.

Failure You take a –10-foot status penalty to your Speeds and are enfeebled 1.

Critical Failure You are immobilized and enfeebled 2.

Effect: Volcanic Purge.name: 效果：火山洗礼 Volcanic Purge
Effect: Volcanic Purge.description: 你承受此持续火焰伤害期间，你的速度承受-10状态减值。

Effect: Viscous Breath.name: Effect: Viscous Breath
Effect: Viscous Breath.description: Creatures in the aura take a –2 status penalty to any non-magical physical attacks they attempt.

Effect: Focused Assault.name: 效果：聚焦突袭 Focused Assault
Effect: Focused Assault.description: 生物造成额外伤害，数额取决于它正持握的武器数量。

Effect: Brutal Rally.name: 效果：残忍激励 Brutal Rally
Effect: Brutal Rally.description: 你的攻击检定获得+1环境加值。

Effect: Countered by Water.name: 效果：为水所克 Countered by Water
Effect: Countered by Water.description: 生物的攻击骰承受-1环境惩罚，他们的颚咬攻击不再造成火焰伤害。

Effect: Recount Epic.name: Effect: Recount Epic
Effect: Recount Epic.description: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics, Athletics, and Performance checks.

Effect: Splintered Ground.name: 效果：粉碎地面 Splintered Ground
Effect: Splintered Ground.description: 生物所有速度都受到-10尺环境减值。

Effect: Funereal Dirge.name: Effect: Funereal Dirge
Effect: Funereal Dirge.description: The creature takes a –2 status penalty to saving throws against drain life.

Effect: Aura of Smoke.name: Effect: Aura of Smoke
Effect: Aura of Smoke.description: Every creature within the aura is concealed.

Effect: Read the Cards.name: Effect: Read the Cards
Effect: Read the Cards.description:
Roll 1d6 to determine a suit. The harrowkin gains the effects of the suit for 1 minute. If the suit matches the harrowkin's suit, the value is doubled.

Hammers The harrowkin gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls.

Keys The harrowkin gains a +1 status bonus to AC.

Shields The harrowkin gains fast healing 5.

Books The harrowkin gains a +1 status bonus to skill checks.

Stars The harrowkin gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws.

Crown The harrowkin can reroll 1 check within the next minute and take the higher result. This is a fortune effect.

Effect: Black Cat Curse.name: 效果：黑猫诅咒 Black Cat Curse
Effect: Black Cat Curse.description: 每当你试图进行攻击骰或豁免时，你必须掷骰两次并使用较低的结果。

Effect: Scent of Blood.name: Effect: Scent of Blood
Effect: Scent of Blood.description: You 10 temporary HP and a +4 status bonus to damage rolls with your unarmed attacks, but become off-guard.

Effect: War Cry.name: Effect: War Cry
Effect: War Cry.description: You deal an additional 1d6 damage with your Strikes.

Effect: Sinful Bite.name: 效果：原罪之噬 Sinful Bite
Effect: Sinful Bite.description: 你在速度上承受-10尺状态减值。

Effect: Hunt Will.name: Effect: Hunt Will
Effect: Hunt Will.description: The steed gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek the prey and to Survival checks to Track the prey. The first time the steed hits its designated prey in a round, it deals an additional 1d8 precision damage.

Effect: Surgical Rend.name: Effect: Surgical Rend
Effect: Surgical Rend.description: Until the creature is restored to its maximum Hit Points, thus closing the wound, Strikes against the creature deal 1d6 extra precision damage.

Effect: Serpent Mode.name: Effect: Serpent Mode
Effect: Serpent Mode.description:
The clockwork serpent transforms into a different mode. Roll 1d3 and consult the options below.

1 Cobra Mode The clockwork serpent can use Intimidating Hood.

2 Constrictor Mode The clockwork serpent can use its coils Strike and can Constrict.

3 Rattlesnake Mode The clockwork serpent can use Shattering Rattle.

Effect: Guardian's Aegis.name: 效果：向导之护 Guardian's Aegis
Effect: Guardian's Aegis.description: 在羽熊30尺范围内的所有盟友获在对抗魔法效果的豁免掷骰上获得+1状态加值。若效果来源为魔族，则该加值增加至+2。

Effect: Inhale Light.name: Effect: Inhale Light
Effect: Inhale Light.description: The torcheater gains a reach of 10 feet, a +5 foot status bonus to Speed, and fast healing 2. Its resistance to physical damage reduces to 2.

Effect: Susceptible to Mockery (Critical.name: Effect: Susceptible to Mockery (Critical Failure)
Effect: Susceptible to Mockery (Critical.description: The creature gains a +1 status bonus to Strikes and damage rolls against foes.

Effect: Song of Freedom.name: Effect: Song of Freedom
Effect: Song of Freedom.description: The troop's Will saves increase to +29 against all mental effects.

Effect: Disturbing Vision.name: 效果：扰心乱视 Disturbing Vision
Effect: Disturbing Vision.description: 幻视持续[[/gmr 1d4 #Disturbing Visions Duration]]{1d4轮}，并且在此期间，罗刹王和该范围内的所有邪恶生物在所有的检定骰上获得+1状态加值。

Effect: Swig (Clumsy).name: Effect: Swig (Clumsy)
Effect: Swig (Clumsy).description: You gain a +2 item bonus to melee damage rolls and saving throws against fear but are clumsy 1.

Effect: Revealing Hypothesis.name: Effect: Revealing Hypothesis
Effect: Revealing Hypothesis.description: Your strikes against a target creature deal an additional 2d6 precision damage.

Effect: Bravado Aversion.name: Effect: Bravado Aversion
Effect: Bravado Aversion.description: A gargarthezul can't stand to be shown up. The first time each round a creature successfully Demoralizes, Shoves, or Trips a gargarthezul, it takes @Damage[1d6[mental]] damage.

Effect: Bloom Regeneration.name: Effect: Bloom Regeneration
Effect: Bloom Regeneration.description: For the next 4 rounds, the creature gains regeneration 10; this regeneration can be deactivated by cold iron or holy.

Effect: Uncanny Tinker.name: 效果：俺寻思 Uncanny Tinker
Effect: Uncanny Tinker.description: 生物的攻击检定获得+1环境加值。

Effect: Divine Weapon (Chelaxian Cleric).name: Effect: Divine Weapon (Chelaxian Cleric)
Effect: Divine Weapon (Chelaxian Cleric).description: The Chelaxian cleric's Strikes gain the unholy trait and deal an additional 1d4 spirit damage; this damage increases to 2d4 against creatures with the holy trait.

Effect: Align the Stars (Ephemeral).name: Effect: Align the Stars (Ephemeral)
Effect: Align the Stars (Ephemeral).description:
Ephemeral Effect

You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to damage rolls.

Effect: PFS Level Bump (NPC).name: Effect: PFS Level Bump (NPC)
Effect: PFS Level Bump (NPC).description:
Scenarios and quests are designed to challenge PCs whose average level is the lower of the two levels in a given Level Range (i.e., Level Range 1–2 is built to challenge 1st-level PCs, and Level Range 3–4 is built to challenge 3rd-level PCs). Normally, when the Challenge Point total determines that the group's overall power is equivalent to the higher level in a Level Range (e.g. 2nd level in Level Range 1–2), the scenario's scaling will adjust for this.

However, sometimes it is necessary to add a level bump, such as when the scenario's scaling is based on the number of players, or if the scenario lacks a low tier 16-18 scaling.

  • Increase the attack modifiers, attack damage, spell damage, saving throw modifiers, skill modifiers, Perception modifiers, and ACs by 1.
  • Increase the Hit Point total by 10 or by 10%, whichever is higher.
